{{Short description|Indian mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2019}}

'''Vikraman Balaji''' is an [[Indian mathematician]] and is currently a professor  at [[Chennai Mathematical Institute]]. He completed his [[doctorate]] in [[Mathematics]] under the supervision of [[C. S. Seshadri]]. His primary area of research is in [[algebraic geometry]], [[representation theory]] and [[differential geometry]]. Balaji was awarded the 2006 [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award]] in Mathematical Sciences along with [[Indranil Biswas]] "for his outstanding contributions to moduli problems of [[principal bundle]]s over [[algebraic variety|algebraic varieties]], in particular on the Uhlenbeck-Yau compactification of the Moduli Spaces of μ-semistable bundles."
He was elected Fellow of the Indian Academy of Sciences in 2007, Fellow of the [[Indian National Science Academy]] in 2015<ref name="Indian Fellows Elected 2015 (Effective from January 1, 2016)">{{cite web | url=http://www.insaindia.org.in/ref.php | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160521223353/http://insaindia.org.in/ref.php | url-status=usurped | archive-date=21 May 2016 | title=Indian Fellows Elected 2015 (Effective from January 1, 2016) | publisher=INSA | date=2015 | access-date=23 December 2015}}</ref> and was awarded the J.C. Bose National Fellowship in 2009.<ref>CSIR R&D Highlights, Jan. 2007.</ref>
